say:9:1410517006:1.male: And their only aim is just to regain magic, not to rebel?
say:9:1410517006:1.female: And their only aim is just to regain magic, not to rebel?

say:10:1410517007:1.text: Oh, you probably can't understand the depth of our desire for magic.

say:11:1410517008:1.text: Well... Chief Eldric did kill countless innocent people to achieve his aims. That's a fact.

say:12:1410517009:1.text: I know. That's why I'm not trying to defend him.
say:12:1410517009:1.source_cn: 我知道，所以我没有为他们辩解。

say:14:1410517011:0.text: No, they can't do that! Life here is orderly under Her Majesty's rule. We don't want to be dragged into your conflicts!
say:14:1410517011:0.source_cn: 不可以！在女王陛下的治理下，大家的生活井然有序，我们不...

say:16:1410517013:0.text: That's... *Sigh* Anyway, we're living just fine underground. We don't want outsiders interfering!

say:37:1410517034:0.female: You didn't come here to upset Sal'thorin's peace or harm Her Majesty.

say:38:1410517035:0.text: Yes! Great, you finally get it... Should I shed a few tears to show how touched I am?
say:38:1410517035:0.source_cn: 对！很好，你总算理解了……我这时候是不是该哭两声以示感动？

say:41:1410517038:0.source_cn: 至于我，我暂且选择原谅你们吧——换做是我，恐怕也会为了...

say:42:1410517039:0.text: Seems like you've got a friend you can really count on.
